boundary: This is a repository-scoped design threat model, not production certification, penetration testing, host hardening proof, or authority to deploy.

threats.control: compact wrapper, artifact pointer, size, digest, manifest, duplicate guard, acknowledged send
threats.residual: platform limits and private state remain outside this phase
threats.threat: oversized or duplicated composer payload is treated as a valid handoff

threats.control: DESI DR2 zero-download, zero-row, zero-likelihood counters
draft-status, synthetic-only, real-key and external-review gates
threats.threat: draft subordinate-events structure is promoted to final or production
identity-incident or remedy authority is inferred from software

threats.control: layered threat model and human-controlled guest-admin broker
threats.residual: no live host deployment or exhaustive audit
threats.threat: sandbox terms are conflated and host administrator access is delegated

threats.control: purpose, type, size, digest, status, focus, alternatives, recovery
threats.threat: artifact pointer is inaccessible or steals focus

threats.control: replay false, repeatability zero, independent reproduction false
threats.threat: no-replay instruction is misreported as repeatability

threats.control: one-shot acknowledged-send gate against an exact existing task
threats.residual: route remains unsent until terminal proof
threats.threat: a prepared baton is reported as sent
